name: RCL Foods Limited
summary: RCL Foods Limited operates as a food manufacturer in South Africa. The company operates through the Groceries, Baking, and Sugar segments. It is involved in culinary products, including mayonnaise, peanut butter, and rusks; milling, specialty, and bakery products; and breads, buns, rolls, and pies, as well as pet food products and beverages, and sugar and molasses-based feed operations. The company sells its products primarily under the 5 Star, Bobtail, bonzo, canine cuisine, catmor, dogmor, Feline Cuisine, MNANDI, Molatek, MONATI, NOLA, Number 1 Megeu, Number 1 Mageu Smooth, Optimizor, OUMA, Pieman, Safari Braaipap, Selati Sprinkle Joy, Sunbake, Supreme Flour, Tafelberg, Ultra Pet, Yapper, …
